title: Campaign CRUD GraphQL API
description: GraphQL mutations and queries to create, read, update, and soft-delete campaigns using Django + Strawberry.
acceptance_criteria: Campaign Django model with: id (UUID), name, description, status, createdAt, updatedAt, isDeleted
GraphQL mutation createCampaign returns created campaign
GraphQL query campaigns returns paginated list
GraphQL query campaign(id) returns single campaign with content pieces
GraphQL mutation updateCampaign updates campaign fields
GraphQL mutation deleteCampaign soft-deletes a campaign
Input validation rejects empty name and malformed payloads
Django admin registered for Campaign model
test_requirements: Unit test for Campaign model: create, get_by_id, update, delete, list_all
GraphQL query tests for campaigns and campaign(id)
GraphQL mutation tests for create, update, delete
Test validation rejects empty name
Test soft delete sets isDeleted=True
done_when: All tests pass (≥80% coverage on campaigns app)
Security reviewer has confirmed no secrets exposed
API can be tested via GraphQL playground

title: Content Piece CRUD GraphQL API
description: GraphQL mutations and queries for content pieces within a campaign using Django + Strawberry.
acceptance_criteria: ContentPiece Django model with: id (UUID), campaignId (FK), headline, description, body, language, state, originalId, createdAt, updatedAt, isDeleted
GraphQL query contentPieces(campaignId) returns list
GraphQL query content(id) returns single content piece
GraphQL mutation createContentPiece creates with campaignId
GraphQL mutation updateContent updates fields
GraphQL mutation deleteContentPiece soft-deletes
Content belongs to a campaign (foreign key constraint)
Content state defaults to 'draft' via Django EnumField
test_requirements: Unit test for ContentPiece model
GraphQL query tests for contentPieces and content(id)
GraphQL mutation tests for create, update, delete
Test that content cannot be created for non-existent campaign (404)

title: PostgreSQL schema & Django migrations
description: Create Django models, database enums, indices, and migration files.
acceptance_criteria: Campaign model with: id (UUIDField), name, description, status, createdAt, updatedAt, isDeleted
ContentPiece model with: id (UUIDField), campaignId (ForeignKey), headline, description, body, language, state (CharField with choices), originalId (nullable FK), createdAt, updatedAt, isDeleted
Review state choices: draft, suggested_by_ai, reviewed, approved, rejected
Indices on: campaignId, state, isDeleted
Migration is idempotent and reversible (makemigrations + migrate)
test_requirements: python manage.py makemigrations runs without errors
python manage.py migrate applies cleanly
python manage.py migrate <app> zero rolls back correctly
done_when: Migration applies cleanly on fresh PostgreSQL

title: AI provider abstraction layer (OpenAI + Anthropic)
description: Build an abstract AI service in Python that supports both OpenAI and Anthropic providers with fallback logic.
acceptance_criteria: Abstract provider class with generate_draft() and translate() methods
OpenAI provider implements using openai Python SDK
Anthropic provider implements using anthropic Python SDK
Provider selection via environment variable (AI_PROVIDER=openai|anthropic)
Automatic fallback if primary provider fails (rate limit, timeout)
Configurable model name, temperature, max tokens via Django settings
Prompt templates externalized in prompts.py module
test_requirements: Mock-based test for AI service with OpenAI provider
Mock-based test for AI service with Anthropic provider
Test fallback when primary provider throws
Test that all providers raise error when no API key is configured
done_when: All AI unit tests use mocks (no real API calls)

title: AI draft generation GraphQL mutation
description: GraphQL mutation that takes a content brief and generates an AI-powered draft.
acceptance_criteria: GraphQL mutation generateDraft(contentId, brief) triggers AI generation
Response returns generated headline and description
Content state transitions from 'draft' to 'suggested_by_ai' on success
Content state transitions back to 'draft' on AI failure
Original content fields preserved as fallback
test_requirements: Unit test with mocked AI provider returning valid draft
Unit test with mocked AI provider throwing error
GraphQL mutation test: verify state change on success/failure
done_when: AI calls are mocked in tests

title: AI translation/localization GraphQL mutation
description: GraphQL mutation that translates content into a target language using AI.
acceptance_criteria: GraphQL mutation translateContent(contentId, targetLanguage) triggers AI translation
Target language uses ISO 639-1 codes (es, fr, de, etc.)
Response returns translated headline and description
Creates new ContentPiece in target language linked via originalId
New content piece starts in 'suggested_by_ai' state
test_requirements: Unit test with mocked AI provider returning valid translation
Unit test with unsupported language returns error
GraphQL mutation test: verify new content piece is created
done_when: AI calls are mocked in tests

title: Review state machine (state transitions, guards)
description: Implement the review state machine with valid transition guards in Django model layer.
acceptance_criteria: Content state uses Django TextChoices with enum: draft, suggested_by_ai, reviewed, approved, rejected
Valid transitions enforced at the model/service layer
Invalid transitions raise ValidationError (422 equivalent)
State history tracked (optional: state_history via Django model)
Only authorized users can change state
test_requirements: Test all valid transitions succeed
Test all invalid transitions raise ValidationError
Test state persists correctly in database
done_when: Code reviewer and DB reviewer have approved

title: Review GraphQL mutations (approve, reject, request edits)
description: GraphQL mutations for human reviewers to approve, reject, or request edits on AI-suggested content.
acceptance_criteria: GraphQL mutation reviewContent(contentId, action: APPROVE) sets state to 'approved'
GraphQL mutation reviewContent(contentId, action: REJECT) sets state to 'rejected'
GraphQL mutation reviewContent(contentId, action: REQUEST_EDITS) sets state to 'reviewed' and stores feedback
GraphQL mutation editContent(contentId, ...) updates body and resets state to 'draft'
Invalid action returns error
Review feedback stored in state_history
test_requirements: Unit test for each review action
GraphQL mutation test for invalid action
GraphQL mutation test: verify state change via DB query
